_doc: Tier-3 OOS: real venture (Clay Labs) — outbound prospecting / data-enrichment platform. Raised $46M Series B from Sequoia + First Round (mid-2024); valued ~$1.25B. Strict OOS — venture and case constructed from public press only.
_oos_provenance: Clay Labs Series B announcement (Sequoia 2024); ProductHunt launch; G2 reviews

venture_under_test.name: Clay Labs
venture_under_test.description: Clay Labs is a B2B SaaS prospecting + data-enrichment platform combining 75+ data providers (Apollo, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, etc.) into a spreadsheet-like UI for revenue teams to build custom outbound campaigns. Target customers: B2B SaaS companies with 50-1000 employees running outbound sales. Pricing: $149-$800/month tiered by enrichment credits + per-seat. Target buyer: Director of Sales Development, RevOps Manager, and Growth Marketer. Competes with Apollo.io, ZoomInfo, Lusha, Cognism, and Outreach. Differentiation: spreadsheet-native workflow with formula-style logic combining multiple data providers in one row, AI-research agents that scrape websites + LinkedIn for non-templated personalization, and credit-based pricing (vs flat per-seat).
